name: Deprecate legacy API and implement modern Promise API with adapter
description: Implement modern Async API in src/modern.ts and legacy adapter in src/adapter.ts with deprecation warnings.

inputs.task_prompt: Create the modern async API in src/modern.ts: fetchUser(id: string): Promise<{ id: string, name: string }>. In src/adapter.ts, implement legacyFetchUserAdapter(id: string, cb: (err: Error | null, res?: { id: string, name: string }) => void): void which wraps fetchUser, delegates callbacks, and emits console.warn('DEPRECATION WARNING: legacyFetchUser is deprecated. Use fetchUser instead.'). In src/legacy.ts, re-export legacyFetchUserAdapter as fetchUserLegacy. All tests in test/migration.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: fetchUser in src/modern.ts returns a Promise
legacyFetchUserAdapter in src/adapter.ts provides callback API and emits deprecation warning
